sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: *Hová*? asks where someone is going. Use a destination form with movement verbs such as *megy* and jön.

items.english: Károly is going to the shop.

sections.content: Hová? is Hol?’s more energetic cousin — Hol? asks where something sits still, Hová? asks where it’s headed. Keep the accent in mind too: that á makes it a genuinely different word, not just a longer version of hova by accident.
